organization.name: brainbot (Shutter Network)
organization.summary: brainbot is a core contributor to Shutter Network, a threshold-encryption protocol for fair and private blockchain use (Shielded Trading, Shielded Voting, Shutter API), governed by Shutter DAO. The brainbot-com GitHub organization (brainbot gmbh) was created 2013-05-07 and the shutter-network organization 2021-06-24. Shutter ran an encrypted mempool on Gnosis Chain for over two years and decommissioned it on 2026-11-25. Public team size: Not found in public sources.

Possible TheDAO Security Fund Round 1 match, not confirmed: Encrypt the Mempool!

delivery.grant: TheDAO Security Fund Round 1: Encrypt the Mempool! Stopping Toxic MEV & Censorship (possible match)
delivery.promised: The Round 1 record lists no deliverables. It is listed under shutter.network. The match to brainbot is only on the name Shutter, so it is not confirmed.

claims.method: The EIP page lists Jannik Luhn (@jannikluhn) as author. Status Draft, created 2025-12-17.

claims.claim: The team is actively contributing to EIP-8184 (LUCID).
claims.method: EIP-8184 (Draft) lists Anders Elowsson, Justin Florentine and Julian Ma as authors, not brainbot staff. Shutter's blog says it aims to contribute to LUCID. Contributions to the text were not checked.

claims.claim: Shutter deployed encrypted mempool technology on Gnosis Chain.
claims.method: Shutter's blog says Gnosis Chain was the first mainnet to run a Shutter encrypted mempool, for over two years, and that it would be decommissioned on 2026-11-25. The deployment is therefore past, not live. These are Shutter's own statements.

claims.claim: A Shutterized OP Stack testnet was launched on Sepolia.
claims.method: No public post or repository confirming the OP Stack testnet on Sepolia was found.

claims.claim: More than USD 1.8 billion was extracted through MEV since 2020.
claims.method: The coalition site and Shutter's post repeat the figure. No primary data source was linked, and the figure was not recomputed.

claims.claim: brainbot coordinates the Encrypt the Mempool coalition.
claims.method: The site lists Shutter among its members. Which organization coordinates the coalition is not stated on the pages checked.

claims.claim: EIP-8184 is proposed for inclusion in I*.
claims.method: The EIP is a Draft. The proposal itself says inclusion is outside the grant and depends on Ethereum's upgrade process.
